mode_inference_decision.rationale: Existing original high-poly contour is resampled into a diagnostic cage; this is a 3D project extension, not one of the bitmap production profiles. No third-party character, rig or animation asset is used.

allowed_operations: original diagnostic skeleton and authored poses
diagnostic_exceptions: Flat neutral material, wire overlay and local end caps are QA-only. They are not formal art.
Exact source crop can have open section boundaries and is reference-only, never exported to runtime.
acceptance_gates: Reject merged torso and open source contours before sampling
Preserve hard armor silhouette; establish both directions of source deviation before production approval
No zero-area triangles; expected closed oriented topology
90-degree bend retains at least 80 percent section area, with no visible folded surfaces or verified triangle intersections
45-degree twist keeps cross-section principal radii within 10 percent and spreads flexible-layer twist
Hard armor is segmented and rigid; it cannot share flexible sleeve deformation
Exported GLB endpoint positions match measured Blender poses within 0.01mm
Independent visual review of source, neutral, bend, twist and combined pose
failed_gates: Current joined cage loses armor edges at t=.25-.40 and .725-.80
Supported bend still has visible inside folds
Hard armor remains part of the deforming tube
Source residual is only directed and reaches 15.48mm
next_work: Retain source contour extraction, discard current armor-crossing faces. Build local flexible elbow sleeve plus separate rigid upper-arm, elbow and forearm armor from the original source.
